704639.t: PIE word *h₁én From Proto-Indo-European *h₁én (“in”), cognate with Latin in, Old Armenian ի (i), Albanian një, English in.

704631.t: From ἐμφαίνω (emphaínō, “I show, present”, from ἐν- (en-) + φαίνω (phaínō)) + -σις (-sĭs).

704675.t: εἷς (heîs, “one”, masculine and neuter stem: ἑν-) + δέκα (dékă, “ten”)

704676.t: From εἷς (heîs, “one”, masculine and neuter stem: ἑν-) + δέκατος (dékătos, “tenth”).

704638.t: From ἐμφύω (emphŭ́ō, “implant”) + -τος (-tos), from ἐν- (en-, “in”) + φύω (phŭ́ō, “bring forth, produce”).

704690.t: From ἔνδον (éndon, “within”) + -γενής (-genḗs). Compare with Latin indigenus.

704678.t: From ἐνδελεχέω (endelekhéō). Possibly related to latin Latin indulgeō, see there for more information.

704698.t: From ἐνδύω (endúō, “to clothe”) and the suffix -μα (-ma).

704636.t: From ἐν- (en-, “in, into”) + φυσάω (phūsáō, “to blow, to puff”), from φῦσα (phûsă, “pair of bellows”) + -άω (-áō, verbal suffix).
